findings.claim: Coresight 估計 2026 年美國零售業開約 5,500 店、關約 7,900 店；Dollar General 計畫開 450 店、Aldi 180 店，折扣業者是擴張主力。
findings.source: ConsumerAffairs, Retail comeback? 900+ stores set to open across the U.S. in 2026
findings.excerpt: Coresight Research estimates U.S. retailers will open about 5,500 new stores this year (up 4.4% year over year) and close about 7,900 stores.

findings.claim: Walmart 計畫 2026 年改裝 650 間以上門市，並在 2026 年底至 2027 年初新開約 20 間，約為 2025 年（9 間）的兩倍多；公司未揭露花費。
findings.source: Chain Store Age / Retail TouchPoints, Walmart to Remodel 650 Stores this Year, Add 20 All-New Ones

findings.claim: Walmart 美國部門 2026-07-31 止季淨銷售 1,252 億美元，年增 3.5%，不含油可比銷售 +2.6%，交易筆數 +1.5%，由高收入家庭帶動。
findings.source: 搜尋摘要（Walmart 財報彙整報導）
findings.excerpt: Walmart U.S. recorded net sales of $125.2 billion, representing year-over-year growth of 3.5%. Comparable sales, excluding fuel, increased 2.6%. Growth was accompanied by a 1.5% increase in transactions

findings.claim: GlobalData：2025 年約 28% 高收入消費者在折扣連鎖（如 Walmart）購物，2021 年約 20%。
findings.excerpt: Research from GlobalData Retail shows that nearly 28% of high-income consumers shopped at discount retailers such as Walmart in 2025, up from around 20% in 2021.

findings.claim: CEO 說明低收入家庭近期承受額外壓力，中等收入家庭穩定，高收入家庭更常來 Walmart。
findings.source: Food Business News, Walmart growth helped by higher income consumers
findings.excerpt: Middle-income households have been steady, and while lower-income families have been under additional pressure of late

findings.claim: Walmart FY2027 營收指引 7,347–7,417 億美元，低於共識 7,518 億美元；Q3 指引亦低於共識。
findings.source: MarketBeat, Walmart issues FY 2027 earnings guidance
findings.excerpt: Its FY2027 revenue guidance of $734.7–$741.7 billion compares with a consensus revenue estimate of $751.8 billion

findings.claim: Bank of America 預測 FY2027/28/29 調整後 EPS 為 2.90／3.20／3.53 美元，並稱美國可比銷售維持 3%–4% 區間。
findings.source: 搜尋摘要（Bank of America 預測轉述）

note: 未找到直接判斷折扣零售『結構性或週期性』供需失衡的來源；供給端僅有店數資料，無產業產能時間表；產業層 2027–2028 共識未找到，僅 Walmart 個股預測。部分日期為依文章發布時點估計。
